description: This Java class implements a service for retrieving tenant details from a database using JDBC. It provides methods to load tenant information by tenant identifier and to list all tenants.

classes.name: JdbcTenantDetailsService
classes.description: A Spring service class that implements tenant detail retrieval via JDBC, annotated with @Service, utilizing JdbcTemplate for database operations.

methods.name: JdbcTenantDetailsService
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the JdbcTemplate with a DataSource injected via Spring @Autowired with a specific qualifier.

methods.name: loadTenantById
methods.description: Loads tenant details from the database given a tenant identifier, returns a FineractPlatformTenant object, or throws an exception if not found or identifier is invalid.

methods.name: findAllTenants
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all tenants from the database.
